## Loop

- observation: Evidence artifacts existed, but the reasoning chain from observation to next loop was still scattered across generated readers and PR memory.
- hypothesis: A compact evidence graph can make the development loop navigable by tools without asking an AI to read every narrative document.
- execute: Verify every chain has observation, hypothesis, change, verifier, evidence, decision, and next-loop nodes; verify repository refs exist; generate this reader and publish graph evidence in CI.
- evaluate: The verifier fails on incomplete chains, duplicate ids, missing refs, stale generated docs, missing strict workflow evidence, or missing redaction on artifact evidence.
- retrospective: This makes the evidence loop itself inspectable: future agents can see why a loop exists, what changed, what verifies it, and what loop should run next.
